Dogecoin was started on December 6, 2013, by software engineers Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer. It originated as a lighthearted and humorous cryptocurrency inspired by the popular "Doge" meme featuring a Shiba Inu dog with broken English captions in Comic Sans font.
